# 23rd ASEAN–India Summit and 21st East Asia Summit – Manila (17 Nov 2026)
- **23rd ASEAN–India Summit**: **Manila, Philippines**, **17 Nov 2026**, at the invitation of President **Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.**; Philippines' ASEAN theme "**Navigating Our Future, Together**"; PM Modi's **13th** interaction with ASEAN leaders in this format; the Philippines has been **India's Country Coordinator in ASEAN since 2024**.
- **Nine Indian initiatives** at the ASEAN–India Summit: **free e-visas for tourists from all 11 ASEAN states**; a long-term **ASEAN–India Maritime Cooperation Plan** (connectivity, research, disaster management, Coast Guard cooperation, maritime domain awareness, seafarers' security); **Joint Cyber Forensics Training Programme**; **nuclear-energy technical exchanges**; an **ASEAN–India Space Hackathon**; **mining and critical minerals** cooperation; **ASEAN–India Youth Connect**; more **Nalanda University** scholarships; an **ASEAN–India Creative Partnership Pavilion at WAVES 2027**.
- Outcome document: **ASEAN–India Joint Statement on Cooperation in Disaster Management** (early warning, satellite and seismic data sharing, joint drills, HADR deployment) linking **ACDM**, the **AHA Centre** and India's **NDMA**.
- Modi: "**cooperation, not competition**"; India and ASEAN ≈ **a quarter of the world's population**; **ASEAN Community Vision 2045** and **Viksit Bharat 2047**; **2027 = 35 years of ASEAN–India relations and 5 years of the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership**.
- **21st East Asia Summit** (Manila, 17 Nov 2026): Modi announced **four initiatives** – **Seafarers' Safety Initiative** (joint training, emergency response), an **EAS Cyber Crime Conference** at the **National Forensic Sciences University**, an **EAS Maritime Heritage Festival at Lothal (Gujarat)** and an **EAS University Heads Conclave at Nalanda**; the EAS adopted a **Joint Statement on combating online scams**.
- **EAS**: set up **2005**; **18 members** – 11 ASEAN states + India, China, Japan, South Korea, Australia, New Zealand, the US and Russia.
# 49th ASEAN Summit – Manila (15–17 Nov 2026)
- **ASEAN DEFA (Digital Economy Framework Agreement)** signed in Manila (economic ministers, **14 Nov 2026**) – called the **first region-wide digital economy agreement**; aims to **double ASEAN's digital economy to US$2 trillion by 2030**.
- **ASEAN Leaders' Declaration on AI-Powered MSME Growth** adopted on **15 Nov 2026**; other declarations: regional MSME development, an **ASEAN Centre of Excellence for Creative Industries in Manila**, fair and ethical recruitment of migrant workers; **150+ outcome documents** in all.
- Chair handover: Marcos passed the gavel to Singapore PM **Lawrence Wong** – **Singapore = ASEAN Chair 2027**, the year of **ASEAN's 60th anniversary** (ASEAN founded **1967**; **11 members** with **Timor-Leste**).
- On the sidelines, Japan's PM **Sanae Takaichi** proposed an **Asia Oil Security Task Force** (17 Nov 2026, **Asia Zero Emission Community – AZEC** summit) – shared oil stockpiling, an "**Asian version of the IEA**" with a possible hub in **Tokyo**, **ERIA (Jakarta)** as possible secretariat.
# 7th Quad Leaders' Summit – Manila (17 Nov 2026)
- **7th Quad Leaders' Summit**, **Manila, 17 Nov 2026**, on the margins of the ASEAN Summit – **first in about two years** (last: **Wilmington, Delaware, September 2024**); leaders **Donald Trump, Anthony Albanese, Narendra Modi, Sanae Takaichi**; Modi called the Quad a "**constructive and trusted**" partnership.
- Outcomes: inaugural **Quad Business Leaders' Forum** – **Mumbai, early 2027** (India's proposal); **Indo-Pacific Maritime Surveillance Collaboration**; **Quad Partnership for Cable Connectivity and Resilience**; cyber and counter-terrorism cooperation; **Quad AI ("Super Intelligence") Accelerator** with **US$85 million+** – first announced by Quad Foreign Ministers in **Atlanta (31 Oct 2026)**.
- Manila link: Quad officials first met in **Manila in 2007** and revived the dialogue in **Manila in 2017**; 2026 = **10th anniversary of the Free and Open Indo-Pacific (FOIP)** vision of **Shinzo Abe (2016)**.
# APEC 2026 and the first US–China–Russia trilateral
- **33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting**, **Shenzhen, China, 18–19 Nov 2026** (**21 member economies**; India is **not** a member): **Xi Jinping** pledged "**free and open trade**" with the **WTO at its core**.
- **First-ever trilateral summit** of the presidents of **China, the US and Russia** (**Xi, Trump, Putin**) scheduled in **Shenzhen on 19 Nov 2026**, hosted by Xi; agenda: Ukraine, the Iran war, AI and **nuclear arms reduction** after the **New START** treaty (US–Russia) **expired in February 2026**.
# COP31 (Antalya) – Indian engagements
- **LeadIT 3.0**: **India and Sweden** launched the third phase of the **Leadership Group for Industry Transition** at COP31 on **17 Nov 2026** (mandate **2027–2030**); **Brazil joined** as the newest member; co-chaired by **Bhupender Yadav** and Sweden's **Helena Dyrssen**; LeadIT was launched in **2019 at the UN Climate Action Summit, New York**.
- Yadav at COP31: India's **emissions intensity fell 37.38% (2005–2022)**; **50% non-fossil installed power capacity** reached **five years early**; he addressed the **4th High-Level Ministerial Roundtable on Just Transition** (**UAE Just Transition Work Programme**) and the **CDRI** Ministerial Dialogue (18 Nov).
- **Antalya AI Pledge** (launched **16 Nov 2026** by host **Türkiye**): voluntary, to power AI with cleaner energy; **90 endorsements** at launch; **Alibaba** the only big-tech signatory; the **US stayed away** from COP for a second year. UN SG **António Guterres** at the leaders' segment (11 Nov): "the climate crisis is outrunning us".
# Other conferences
- **62nd Session and Ministerial Meeting of the International Coconut Community (ICC)**: **Kochi, Kerala**, **17–20 Nov 2026**, hosted by the **Coconut Development Board** (Ministry of Agriculture) with the ICC (**HQ Jakarta, Indonesia**).
- **Commonwealth Women Parliamentarians (CWP), India Region** conference: **Vidhana Soudha, Bengaluru**, **17–18 Nov 2026**, inaugurated by Lok Sabha Speaker **Om Birla**; theme "**Strong Foundations, Stronger Voices: Inclusive Cyberspace and Mentorship Pathways for New Women Legislators**"; CWP India Region chair **Daggubati Purandeswari**.
- **6th Anti-Terrorism Conference** of the **NIA**: **New Delhi, 19–20 Nov 2026**, addressed by Home Minister **Amit Shah**.
- **UAE National Festival of Tolerance and Coexistence (8th edition)**: **Abu Dhabi, 13–15 Nov 2026** – **India = Country Guest of Honour**; theme "**Growing in Unity**"; marks the **International Day for Tolerance (16 Nov)**.
> ⚠ Trap: the Quad summit was in **Manila**, not India – India will host only the **Business Leaders' Forum (Mumbai, 2027)**; ASEAN chair 2026 = **Philippines**, 2027 = **Singapore**; APEC 2026 = **Shenzhen (China)** and India is not an APEC member; LeadIT is **India–Sweden**, launched **2019**.

# ASEAN and Quad – documents and frameworks (Nov 2026)
- **ASEAN–India Joint Statement on Cooperation in Disaster Management** (23rd ASEAN–India Summit, **Manila, 17 Nov 2026**): whole disaster cycle (prevention, preparedness, response, recovery); voluntary sharing of **satellite, seismic and meteorological data**; regular consultations of the **ASEAN Committee on Disaster Management (ACDM)**, the **AHA Centre** (ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance on Disaster Management) and India's **NDMA**; use of AI in disaster-risk assessment.
- **ASEAN DEFA (Digital Economy Framework Agreement)**: signed in **Manila** by ASEAN economic ministers (**14 Nov 2026**) during the Philippine chairship – billed as the **world's first region-wide digital economy agreement**; common rules on digital trade, e-commerce, e-payments and data flows; target: ASEAN digital economy from about **US$1 trillion to US$2 trillion by 2030**.
- **ASEAN Leaders' Declaration on AI-Powered MSME Growth** (49th ASEAN Summit, **15 Nov 2026**) – AI readiness, PPPs, affordable AI tools and AI literacy for small firms.
- **Quad frameworks** (Manila, 17 Nov 2026): **Indo-Pacific Maritime Surveillance Collaboration** (first Quad-context patrol-aircraft exercise in 2027), **Quad Partnership for Cable Connectivity and Resilience** (Australia adding **electricity cables**), Quad Cybersecurity Cooperation, and the **Super Intelligence (AI) Accelerator** (from the **Atlanta** Foreign Ministers' meeting).
# Technology and trade pacts
- **San Francisco Declaration on the Secure Foundations of Enduring Prosperity** (**15 Nov 2026**): signed by **10 founders of the US-led Pax Silica** – **US, Australia, India, Israel, Japan, South Korea, Qatar, Singapore, UAE, UK** – to safeguard **AI supply chains** (joint list of critical technologies; **five working groups**); convened by US Under Secretary **Jacob Helberg**. **Pax Silica** launched **December 2025**.
- **AGOA (African Growth and Opportunity Act)**: President Trump (**2 Nov 2026**) started termination of **South Africa and Rwanda** from AGOA – deadline **January 2027**; AGOA created in **2000** (Bill Clinton) for duty-free US access for eligible African countries.
- **India–Egypt**: at the **7th Joint Trade Committee** (first at **ministerial level**; **New Administrative Capital**, **16 Nov 2026**; Piyush Goyal and **Mohamed Farid Saleh**) both sides agreed a **Joint Working Group** to frame terms of reference for a **PTA / FTA (CEPA)** and a **US$12 billion trade target**; trade **US$6.5 billion in FY 2025-26 (+35%)**; Indian investment in Egypt **over US$5.5 billion**.
- **India–Thailand 14th Joint Trade Committee** (**Nonthaburi**, 16 Nov 2026): trade **US$21.49 billion in FY 2025-26 (+12.6%)**; Thailand = **16.7% of India's trade with ASEAN**; both want an early conclusion of the **AITIGA** review; also the **India–Thailand Early Harvest Scheme**.
- **India–Belarus 12th Inter-Governmental Commission** (New Delhi, 16 Nov 2026): co-chaired by MoS **Jitin Prasada** and Belarus FM **Maxim Ryzhenkov**; Protocol signed; **Roadmap for Cooperation 2027–2031** under discussion.
- **Basmati GI**: **Pakistan secured GI recognition for Basmati in Türkiye** (May 2026, reported 16 Nov 2026) after India's 2023 application to the **Turkish Patent Office**; Pakistan registered Basmati as GI at home in **January 2021**; Pakistan also contests India's **2018 EU PGI** application; Australia's Federal Court dismissed **APEDA**'s appeal (Aug 2026).
# Science cooperation with Italy
- **Elettra 2.0**: India committed **over €7 million over five years (from 2026-27)** as a co-partner in redeveloping beamlines at **Elettra Sincrotrone Trieste (Italy)**; India is Elettra's **second-largest user** after Italy (since **1998**); new beamlines **μXRD** and **Xpress-SB** – announced by **Dr Jitendra Singh** (13 Nov 2026).
- **India–ICTP Co-operation Fund**: Letter of Intent between **DST** and the **International Centre for Theoretical Physics (ICTP), Trieste** (est. **1964**).
# UN bodies and international organisations
- **PAHO** (Pan American Health Organization, WHO's regional office for the Americas) on **17 Nov 2026** said the **US, Mexico and Bolivia lost their measles elimination status** (12 months of sustained transmission); **Canada** lost it in **2025**; the Americas were the **first WHO region** certified measles-free (**2016**).
- **UNDRR** recognised **GIFT City (Gandhinagar)** as a **Resilience Hub** under **Making Cities Resilient 2030 (MCR2030)** on **17 Nov 2026** – **India's first**, the **45th globally**; MCR2030 launched **October 2020**.
- **ICJ** (The Hague) to deliver its ruling on **19 Nov 2026** in **The Gambia v. Myanmar** (case filed **2019**) on whether the **2017** campaign against the **Rohingya** was genocide under the **1948 Genocide Convention** – its first substantive genocide ruling in over a decade.
- **India–Oman–UAE trilateral technical committee** on flight operations and regional airspace (announced **12 Nov 2026** by Civil Aviation Minister **K. Ram Mohan Naidu**), paving the way for talks between the **ICAO Middle East (MID)** and **Asia-Pacific (APAC)** regions.
- **COP31 (Antalya)**: India called for a **country-driven Just Transition Mechanism** (with finance and technology) at the 4th Ministerial Roundtable under the **UAE Just Transition Work Programme** (16 Nov); the **Antalya AI Pledge** got **90 endorsements** at launch; **LeadIT 3.0 (2027–2030)** launched by **India and Sweden**, Brazil joining.
> ⚠ Trap: the San Francisco Declaration belongs to **Pax Silica** (AI/semiconductor supply chains), not the Quad; GIFT City's UN tag is from **UNDRR**, not UN-Habitat; PAHO stripped the **US, Mexico and Bolivia** (Canada lost its status a year earlier); ICTP and Elettra are both in **Trieste, Italy**.

# PM Modi in Manila (16–17 Nov 2026) – bilaterals
- PM Modi's two-day visit to the **Philippines (16–17 Nov 2026)**: **23rd ASEAN–India Summit**, **21st East Asia Summit** and the **7th Quad Leaders' Summit**; he laid the foundation stone for redeveloping **Gurudwara Khalsa Diwan, Manila** – the **oldest gurudwara in the Philippines** (over a century old).
- **India–Philippines**: Modi met President **Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.** – the **Strategic Partnership** dates from Marcos's **State Visit to India in August 2025**; areas: defence, space, railways, fintech; the Philippines = **India's Country Coordinator in ASEAN since 2024**. Trump then announced a new **US–Philippines trade deal** before flying to China.
- **India–Singapore**: Modi met PM **Lawrence Wong** – **Comprehensive Strategic Partnership (September 2024)**; roadmap with **eight priority areas** (adopted during Wong's India visit, September 2025); Singapore takes the **ASEAN chair in 2027**.
- **India–Thailand**: Modi met PM **Anutin Charnvirakul** – ties elevated to a **Strategic Partnership in April 2025** (Modi's Thailand visit).
# India–Japan
- **4th India–Japan 2+2 Foreign and Defence Ministerial Dialogue**: **Tokyo, 19 Nov 2026** – **Rajnath Singh and S. Jaishankar** with Japan's Defence Minister **Shinjiro Koizumi** and Foreign Minister **Toshimitsu Motegi**; Jaishankar also holds the **19th India–Japan Foreign Ministers' Strategic Dialogue**; ties = **Special Strategic and Global Partnership**.
- Rajnath Singh and Koizumi (18 Nov 2026) toured the **Mogami-class stealth frigate JS Natori** at **Yokosuka**; their **third meeting of 2026** (after New Delhi, August, and the **ADMM-Plus at Cebu**, October). Rajnath: India's defence production **over ₹1.80 lakh crore**, defence exports a record **₹38,000 crore**.
- **JAIMEX 2026**: India–Japan naval exercise, **13–14 Nov 2026**, **south of Honshu** – **INS Sahyadri** (Shivalik-class stealth frigate) with **JS Ise** (helicopter destroyer).
# Defence exercises
- **MALABAR 2026**: **5–12 Nov 2026**, navies of **India, Japan, the US and Australia**; the exercise's **30th year** and **sixth edition with all four Quad navies**; India's **INS Sahyadri** (at **Yokosuka**, Japan); Japan's JS Ise and JS Mogami, Australia's **HMAS Stuart**, US **USS Anchorage** and **USS John P. Murtha**. Malabar began in **1992** as an **India–US** bilateral exercise.
- **First Quad military exercise (2027)**: announced at Manila – **P-8** patrol aircraft of **India, the US and Australia** and Japan's **P-3C** under the **Indo-Pacific Maritime Surveillance Collaboration**, expected within the US-led anti-submarine exercise **Sea Dragon 2027 (Guam)**.
- **Harimau Shakti 2026**: India–**Malaysia** Army exercise, **18–30 Nov 2026**; annual since **2012**, alternating venue; jungle warfare and counter-insurgency; the **5th edition** was at **Mahajan Field Firing Range, Rajasthan (Dec 2025)**.
# Defence deals and visits
- **Barak upgrade**: MoD signed a **₹1,976.40 crore** contract with **Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI)** on **18 Nov 2026** for upgrade and obsolescence management of **Barak Point Defence Missile Systems** on Indian Navy ships (Other Capital Procurement Procedure).
- **BrahMos exports** (CEO **Jaiteerth R. Joshi**, 13 Nov 2026): missiles **supplied to the Philippines**; agreement with **Vietnam** signed **May 2026** (initial tranche about **US$100 million**); **Indonesia** placed a shore-based order (**July 2026**). BrahMos = solid booster + **liquid-fuelled ramjet**.
- **COAS General Dhiraj Seth** in the **Czech Republic**, **16–19 Nov 2026** (Prague; **Defence University, Brno**; **NATO Joint CBRN Defence Centre of Excellence**). **Belgian Navy Commander Rear Admiral Tanguy Botman** visited New Delhi (14 Nov 2026) and met Navy Chief **Admiral Krishna Swaminathan**.
# Geopolitics and neighbourhood
- **Strait of Hormuz**: the Panama-flagged LPG tanker **MT Tara Gas** was attacked on **16 Nov 2026** – **21 of 24 Indian crew** evacuated to **Khasab (Oman)**, one Indian missing; India condemned attacks on shipping amid the **US–Israeli war with Iran** (since **February 2026**).
- **Russia–Ukraine**: first direct peace talks **since February** in **Abu Dhabi, 10–11 Nov 2026**, brokered by the US (envoys **Steve Witkoff** and **Jared Kushner**; Ukraine's negotiator **Rustem Umerov**).
- **Xi–Trump–Putin**: first-ever **China–US–Russia trilateral** summit set for **Shenzhen, 19 Nov 2026** (APEC sidelines); Trump to raise **nuclear-arms cuts** after **New START expired (Feb 2026)**; Putin and Xi pushed a "**multipolar world order**".
- **Japan** scrambled jets (17 Nov 2026) after suspected **Russian** aircraft entered its airspace near **Okinoshima, off Fukuoka** (via the **Tsushima Strait**); Russian aircraft also entered South Korea's **KADIZ** over the East Sea.
- **Nepal**: India's **Central Electricity Authority** (17 Nov 2026) allowed the **Nepal Electricity Authority** to import **up to 350 MW** until **31 July 2027** via the **Indian Energy Exchange** (Day-Ahead and Real-Time markets); 300 MW on Kataiya–Kushaha, Ramnagar–Surajpura and Raxaul–Parwanipur lines, 50 MW on New Nautanwa–Mainahiya.
- **Bangladesh**: Unit 1 of **Rooppur NPP** (Ishwardi, **Pabna**; **Rosatom**, 2 × **VVER-1200**) connected to the grid on **17 Nov 2026** – Bangladesh the **33rd country** to generate nuclear power.
- New diplomatic tracks: **first India–Lebanon Foreign Office Consultations** (New Delhi, **9 Nov 2026**); **6th India–Ecuador FOC** (10 Nov 2026); Belarus FM **Maxim Ryzhenkov** in New Delhi (16 Nov); Piyush Goyal's Egypt trip (15–16 Nov, his **first bilateral visit to an African country**; met PM **Mostafa Madbouly**), then **Rome** (17 Nov, India–Italy **Special Strategic Partnership**).
> ⚠ Trap: JAIMEX (India–Japan, bilateral, south of Honshu) is different from MALABAR (four Quad navies); the Barak deal is with **IAI (Israel)**, not Rafael; Harimau Shakti is with **Malaysia** (Army), Mitra Shakti with Sri Lanka; the Quad's first military drill is due in **2027** with **Sea Dragon (Guam)**.
